messages:
Maya (SRE): paging — zipper rollout to eu-2 is seeing crashloops on encoder-canary pods, HPA spiking, and a node drain started automatically 
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD#45678 triggered, responder: Sam (oncall)
Sam (oncall): onit. Maya can you paste the failing pod log and current traffic split?
Priya (eng): canary has ~20% traffic. error rate from encoder service +12% (5xx), latency p95 up ~600ms. attaching logs:
Priya (eng): ```
2026-03-17T12:14:22Z encoder-init: mount /mnt/models failed: permission denied
2026-03-17T12:14:23Z container restart backoff
2026-03-17T12:14:25Z liveness probe failed: HTTP 500 /healthz
```
Maya (SRE): initial suspicion: initContainer mounting modelstore from pv with wrong fsGroup after the zipper rollout changed securityContext. Also saw HPA target alarms — autoscaler ramped to 10 replicas then started preemptions on node eu-2b.
Elena (infra): eu-2b was under automated maintenance (kernel patch) and drain triggered; combined with burst traffic pushed pods to failure domain. I can pause the automatic node upgrade for eu-2 cluster.
Sam (oncall): decision needed: rollback deployment OR feature-flag kill-switch to stop traffic to canary. Jon, Priya — what's the fastest mitigation?
Jon (prod): kill the zipper feature flag to cut traffic to canary immediately, then rollback the deployment once stable. We want minimal customer impact and preserve metrics.
Priya (eng): agreed. Kill flag is fastest. I have ff-admin access. I'll flip the flag now.
deploy-bot: ```
ff-admin toggle --flag zipper_canary --env prod --off
Response: flag zipper_canary turned OFF
Traffic routing: stable receives 100% -> OK
```
Sam (oncall): monitoring — errors dropping?
Maya (SRE): errors dropped from +12% to baseline within 90s. Latency normalizing. HPA cool-down triggered; autoscaler scales down to stable levels.
Priya (eng): starting rollout undo to return pods to pre-rollout RS and will scale canary replicas to 0 as extra safety.
deploy-bot: ```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/encoder --to-revision=42
scaledown: kubectl scale deploy/encoder-canary --replicas=0
Response: rollout undo started, canary scaled to 0
```
Elena (infra): I paused the eu-2 automated maintenance and re-added taint exceptions to prevent further preemptions.
Sam (oncall): nice work. I'll keep paged for 30m and then de-escalate if stable. Please add a short postmortem note and list follow-ups (fix securityContext, integration test for mount perms, protect drains during rollouts).
Jon (prod): adding customer-impact note: transient 5xx affecting ~20% of requests routed to canary for ~3m before kill-switch, minor user-visible errors; no data loss.
Maya (SRE): creating incident ticket INC-20260317-zipper for follow-ups. Closing Slack thread, will update ticket with logs and timeline. :white_check_mark:
